step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture illustrates a pharmaceutical data pipeline. Data originates from various source systems (represented by 'SOURCE/ETL') and lands in an S3 bucket ('Refined Store'). This triggers an AWS Step Functions workflow executing Lambda functions. The Lambda functions interface with Machine Learning models (SageMaker), AWS Translate, and Amazon Comprehend (Comprehend Medical) to extract, translate, and augment adverse event data from clinical narratives. Finally, the processed data is stored in Amazon RDS. Connections flow from SOURCE/ETL -> S3 -> Step Functions / Lambda -> ML / Translate / Comprehend -> RDS.
